# GPU project probe fixture

`reflected-shear-v7.obrush` (SHA-256 `cd59216de8039d6d73026e92851923a317530ff6bd92f7b6b6ea5494cd22a2d5`) is an OBrush v7 save from an earlier import of the included independently authored `reflected-shear-v3.sgl` scene (SHA-256 `dbf724eacab383f647ec8f36655424d53cb14cf60e74d258ea10a169f8ee5c69`). It was authored as a five-point mixed quad/triangle fixture with explicit RGB, material, UV and mask channels and a reflected/sheared affine pose; it is not a commercial ZBrush file or a SculptGL-generated output.

The saved form tests the public OBrush project decoder and exact retained pose. The GPU probe's expected face IDs come independently from `Document::raycast_scene`, not from replaying its own GPU result. See [the C114 report](../../../../docs/WEBGPU_DOCUMENT_C114.md).

`reflected-shear-nonplanar-v7.obrush` (SHA-256 `cc3ebbca73d6c2de2ac2d8a53a5421a2beba4fc4ddf3af7229a9f4d96b49b895`) is an independently edited v7 derivative of that saved project: editable vertex 2 has local z `0.5` and vertex 4 has local z `-0.25`. Its immutable SGL origin remains the original independently authored scene. The bent editable faces give non-axis-aligned computed normals, making the saved affine's inverse-transpose normal transform visible in the GPU lighting test. See [the C115 report](../../../../docs/WEBGPU_AFFINE_NORMALS_C115.md).

`resident-sphere-162.obrush` (SHA-256 `ab16459719d55e25d49fa8c2cc0fd16809749a991a6d08e960f6a822d34afe0a`) is an OBrush v2 save of `Document::new(Mesh::sphere(2))`, generated by the independently written Rust core through `resident_commit_probe`. Its 162 vertices and 320 triangles have default unprotected brush influence. It is the identical input to the C117 native Metal and browser WebGPU/WASM document-commit comparison; the original project bytes, GPU position readback and accepted project bytes are compared independently of images. See [the C117 report](../../../../docs/WEBGPU_BROWSER_COMMIT_C117.md).
